title: I Took the Attendance QR Code to the Lecture They Marked Me Absent

parts.text: I scanned the attendance QR at 9:01 a.m. from the seat I always take, aisle, third row. The portal marked me absent at 9:40. I was nineteen, holding a notes app full of the lecture I had just heard. The professor said the code rotated and I must have been late. I still had the screenshot of the 9:01 success toast. I forwarded it to the TA with the Wi-Fi login timestamp from campus IT, which shows building presence. The absence flipped to present by 10:12. The professor said the system is new. New systems still owe a toast. I kept sitting aisle third. I keep screenshots of toasts now, like a person who has met software. Lecture continued. I was there, which is the only trick attendance should do.

social.video_title: The success toast beat the 9:40 absence — Part 1/1
